title: The Termite Mound
text: A termite mound taller than a house rises from the plain, red as dried blood, humming with a sound like a thousand tiny voices. Something glints in its walls, high up: metal, and the shape of a hand around it.

options.label: The strongest breaks the mound open, to reach the glint in its walls.

outcomes.text: Old coins the termites built around, and the hand still clutching them.
The termites answer, all of them.

options.label: The cleverest smokes them out first, so the dig is quiet.

outcomes.text: A quiet dig, and the coins, and a way through the plain they cleared.

options.label: Leave it be. A thousand voices is too many to anger.

outcomes.text: The humming follows you a while. So do the termites; by morning they have eaten into every strap.

options.label: The Pugilist punches through to the glint, one blow, and damn the insects.

outcomes.text: One blow, a cloud of angry insects, and in the Pugilist's fist a lump of voidglass.
One blow, and the mound bites back all the way up the arm.
